records.source: Chef: Pity. Come back when you're ready for something delicious.
records.translation: 廚師：真可惜。等你準備好享用美食時再回來。

records.source: Race Announcer: The racers need some time to prepare... Come back later!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：選手們需要一點時間準備……晚點再來！

records.source: Race Announcer: Guess the winner and receive some fabulous prizes!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：猜中冠軍，就能獲得精美獎品！

records.source: Race Announcer: Who do you think will win?
records.translation: 賽事播報員：你認為誰會獲勝？

records.source: Race Announcer: {0}? Okay. Now sit back and enjoy the race!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：{0}？好。現在坐下來欣賞比賽吧！

records.source: Race Announcer: Let's see if {0} can pull this off!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：看看{0}能不能成功奪冠！

records.source: Race Announcer: Escar-go... how?? Um...Well, here's your big payout...
records.translation: 賽事播報員：蝸牛衝……怎麼可能？？呃……好吧，這是你的豐厚獎金……

records.source: Race Announcer: Congratulations! Here's your prize!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：恭喜！這是你的獎品！

records.source: Race Announcer: Whoops. Looks like the race has already started. Try again later!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：哎呀，看來比賽已經開始了。晚點再試！

records.source: Race Announcer: The race is currently in progress! Let's talk later...
records.translation: 賽事播報員：比賽正在進行！晚點再聊……

records.source: Race Announcer: The races have ended for the day. I hope you had fun!
records.translation: 賽事播報員：今天的比賽已經結束。希望你玩得開心！

records.source: The next race is about to begin...
records.translation: 下一場比賽即將開始……

records.source: On your marks...
records.translation: 各就各位……

records.source: Get set...
records.translation: 預備……

records.source: GO!
records.translation: 出發！

records.source: Finish!
records.translation: 抵達終點！

records.source: That was a close one!
records.translation: 勝負只在毫釐之間！

records.source: It was neck-and-neck!
records.translation: 雙方不分軒輊！

records.source: Such speed has rarely been seen!
records.translation: 如此驚人的速度實屬罕見！

records.source: And now, the moment you've all been waiting for...
records.translation: 現在，來到各位期待已久的時刻……

records.source: That's the last race for today. We'll see you tomorrow!
records.translation: 這是今天最後一場比賽。明天見！

records.source: And that's it for this year's races! See you next time!
records.translation: 今年的賽事到此結束！下次見！

records.source: This race's winner is...
records.translation: 本場比賽的冠軍是……

records.source: Come by to collect your prize!
records.translation: 過來領取獎品吧！

records.source: Better luck next time!
records.translation: 祝你下次好運！

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Heh... not now, kid. Come back later, and we can talk.
records.translation: 可疑男子：嘿……現在不行，孩子。晚點再來，我們可以談談。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: It's too late, kid. Come back when the races are happening.
records.translation: 可疑男子：太遲了，孩子。比賽舉行時再來。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Eyes on the race, kid! We can talk later...
records.translation: 可疑男子：專心看比賽，孩子！晚點再談……

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Too late, the race's started. Let's talk again later...
records.translation: 可疑男子：太遲了，比賽已經開始。我們晚點再談……

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Psst... Hey, kid. You been watching these races? Pretty exciting, huh?
records.translation: 可疑男子：噓……嘿，孩子。你一直在看這些比賽嗎？很刺激，對吧？

records.source: Suspicious Guy: ... Say, I got a little 'proposition' for ya.
records.translation: 可疑男子：……我說，我有個小小的「提議」要給你。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Just pick a racer, and their next race will be a real stinker... catch my drift?
records.translation: 可疑男子：只要挑一位選手，他下一場就會表現得爛透了……懂我的意思吧？

records.source: Suspicious Guy: It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg. A small price to pay for the 'edge' you'll get.
records.translation: 可疑男子：只收你 1 顆卡利科蛋。為了取得「優勢」，這代價很小。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Need my 'services'? It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg.
records.translation: 可疑男子：需要我的「服務」嗎？只收你 1 顆卡利科蛋。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Alright, so who's gonna be the unlucky racer?
records.translation: 可疑男子：好吧，那麼哪位選手要倒楣了？

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Looks like you don't have any Calico Eggs, kid. Stop wastin' my time.
records.translation: 可疑男子：看來你一顆卡利科蛋也沒有，孩子。別再浪費我的時間。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0}, huh? You got it, kid.
records.translation: 可疑男子：{0}，是吧？交給我，孩子。

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0} it is. Now excuse me, I've got a phone call to make...
records.translation: 可疑男子：就選{0}。先失陪了，我得打通電話……

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0}? Sure, sure... Good luck, kid.
records.translation: 可疑男子：{0}？當然，當然……祝你好運，孩子。
